channel.title: GitTube weekly digest
channel.description: Trending GitHub repos by week: the fastest risers and the top of each lane.

item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 45, 2026 (2–8 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (2–8 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Star-growth numbers appear once GitTube has a few days of history.

This week

  • deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype (TypeScript) ★ 12,745: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
  • heydamir/unslop (JavaScript) ★ 6,032: A Claude skill that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface
  • wangzan101/Mika (Kotlin) ★ 5,205: An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.

Python

  • Gathin23/cleanyourtv (Python) ★ 50,256: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
  • deepseek-ai/DeepInfer (Python) ★ 25,019: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
  • google-research/harness2 (Python) ★ 22,086

Rust

  • storytold/wordcraft (Rust) ★ 17,038: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
  • tangency-labs/solidcraft (Rust) ★ 13,135: SolidCraft: an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Desktop, web, and automation through MCP.
  • storytold/cadcraft (Rust) ★ 7,473: CADCraft: computer-aided design and drafting — an open-source, clean-room AutoCAD-style app in pure Rust

Telecom

  • absmach/magistrala (Go) ★ 2,658: IoT Platform Framework
  • Community-VyProjects/VyManager (TypeScript) ★ 490: Multi-tenant network management platform to configure, deploy, and monitor VyOS instances across multiple sites.
  • praetorian-inc/nerva (Go) ★ 376: Fast service fingerprinting CLI for 170+ protocols (TCP/UDP/SCTP) - built by Praetorian

5G

  • taubyte/tau (Go) ★ 5,182: Fullstack Workspace for Humans & Machines
  • open5gs/open5gs (C) ★ 2,802: Open5GS is a C-language Open Source implementation for 5G Core and EPC, i.e. the core network of LTE/NR network (Release-19)
  • free5gc/free5gc (Go) ★ 2,369: Open source 5G core network based on 3GPP R17
